item.title: AI Breakthrough Promises Faster Language Models
item.description: Researchers at a leading lab have discovered a new training technique that cuts compute costs by 40% while maintaining quality. The approach uses a novel sparse-attention mechanism.

item.title: Critical Zero-Day Found in Popular Web Framework
item.description: A critical remote code execution vulnerability has been discovered in a widely used web framework. Patch version 4.2.1 addresses the issue; all users should upgrade immediately.

item.title: Startup Raises $50M Series B for Autonomous Agents Platform
item.description: An autonomous agents startup announced a $50 million Series B round led by prominent VCs, with plans to expand its enterprise offering and hire 100 engineers this year.
